description: Withdraw one or several of your own open order-book orders (ids from my_orders); reserved CWM (BUY) or goods (SELL) are returned. Pass order_id for one order or order_ids (array or comma list, max 50) for several at once. Returns one result per order (success or error each); an already filled or cancelled order only reports an error for its own entry. Needs no docking.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

order_ids.description: Several order ids, max 50 (a comma-separated string is also accepted)

name: cancel_order
title: Cancel market order
